RESEARCH NOTE

Fewer wrong answers.
Also, fewer answers.

In the reported TriviaQA experiment, increasing tuned Mistral’s threshold from 0 to 0.9 reduced incorrect answers from 146 to 15 across 500 held-out questions. Answer coverage fell from 97.8% to 42.6%. Both belong in the story.

03 / THE ENGINEER

Curious about models.
Serious about
making things work.

I’m completing an MSc in Applied Artificial Intelligence at the University of Warwick, following a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Ropar.

At American Express, I developed SQL fraud-detection scanners and Python automation. At Ambiente Technologies, I worked on face recognition and browser-based video calling.

My current work connects model evaluation with practical application development: asking what a system can do, where it fails, and how to make those boundaries clear.
